title: Stub Shafts
specs: Developed Excel spreadsheet to calculate Marin factors, angular deflection, and Hertzian contact stress
Modeled tripod contact stress and worst-case halfshaft angle in ANSYS Mechanical to identify stress concentrations
Designed under tight timeline; project was first part level design freeze on drivetrain
Validated over 275 miles of testing with no fatigue failures

title: Welding Projects
specs: Independently learned AC (aluminum) TIG welding to expand in-house manufacturing capabilities
First project: a 50 thou motor scatter shield
After much trial and error, a success!

title: Jacking Point
specs: Reduced ANSYS simulation solving time by refining mesh only around stress concentrations and modeling simplified bolt geometry
Learned steel/DC TIG welding and fabricated the 4140 steel component
Designed to interface seamlessly within existing drivetrain and brake assembly constraints

title: Rear Frame Bracket
specs: Designed a bracket to improve structural support and packaging efficiency
Modeled load paths and manufacturing constraints to reduce unnecessary material
Iterated on geometry for better assembly fit and fabrication simplicity
Balanced strength, weight, and ease of welding to produce a functional driveline support solution
